theme: An open Saturday with the girls in St. Pete — nothing on the calendar, a few bookings quietly overdue.
greeting: No meetings today, Dan — the day belongs to you and the four girls. The only real pull is a couple of holiday-travel bookings that have drifted past their windows, with a quiet Sunday ahead.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority board task, overdue since mid-September: reserve a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week. The Pathfinder has gone south, so there is no six-seater in Maine for the holidays — and PWM holiday inventory is the first to sell out.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December trip
needsAttention.detail: Both gates have passed — decide-by was Sept 30, book-by Oct 15. Six people across three holiday weeks is the thinnest inventory of the year; shortlisting a destination only gets harder from here.

needsAttention.title: Skim the DIRA & DIBA materials
needsAttention.detail: The Bridge & Road Association annual meeting is tomorrow at 5 PM on Zoom, and you are on the invite as host. The materials came in a separate email — read them today so you are not opening them cold.

needsAttention.title: Dropbox says files may be deleted
needsAttention.detail: A Dropbox notice warns your account is over its storage limit and files could be removed after Oct 25. Worth a glance today if anything in there still matters.

flagged.title: IFAC director wants to connect
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn invitation from a director at IFAC — squarely your governance and accounting world. Worth a reply given the search.

flagged.title: KPMG Managing Director alert
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a KPMG US Managing Director opening in its job alerts.

flagged.title: Venmo request — $50, mowing
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver requested $50 for lawn mowing dated Oct 14.

flagged.title: Tampa Gardens salon notice
flagged.detail: The Tampa Gardens resident portal announced a new salon provider, with a services and authorization form attached.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and promos — the FT, Monocle, the St. Pete locals, a Fountaine Pajot campaign, and the usual run of Halloween sales.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Pumpkins and winter squash are at their autumn peak — a pot of this warms the whole kitchen.
